translations.字云长。桃园结义后，随大哥刘备征战，同扶汉室。他是武勇忠义的代名词。曾斩颜良、诛: Yunchang. Sworn brother of Liu Bei and Zhang Fei, devoted to restoring the Han. Famed for valor and loyalty, he slew Yan Liang and Wen Chou, traveled far to rejoin Liu Bei, and flooded seven armies. He headed Shu's Five Tiger Generals.
translations.字元让，魏前将军，曹操的族弟。征讨吕布时，被曹性射中左眼，他拔箭啖目、鼓勇而战，: Yuanrang. Cao Cao's kinsman and a leading Wei general. Cao Xing shot out his left eye during the campaign against Lu Bu; he pulled out the arrow, swallowed the eye and killed Cao Xing. Cao Cao trusted him deeply. Cao Pi later made him General-in-Chief.
translations.字公覆。自孙坚举兵即为其部下，江东三代老臣。在赤壁之战中，自献苦肉计诈降曹操，终: Gongfu. A veteran who served three generations of the Sun family, beginning with Sun Jian. At Red Cliffs he accepted punishment to make a false surrender convincing, enabling Wu's fire attack to rout Cao Cao and winning lasting fame.
translations.字奉先，被誉为「人中吕布，马中赤兔」的猛将。武艺高强，弓马娴熟，但生性反复无常，: Fengxian. Celebrated alongside his horse Red Hare for unmatched martial skill, archery and horsemanship. Fickle in loyalty, he repeatedly betrayed his masters. Betrayed by his own men, he was captured by Cao Cao, strangled and beheaded.
translations.字妙才，迎娶曹操之女为妻。是魏国征西将军，善于突袭的勇将。后来驻守定军山时，中了: Miaocai. He married Cao Cao's daughter. A bold Wei general famed for swift surprise attacks. While defending Mount Dingjun, he fell into Fa Zheng's trap and was slain by Huang Zhong.
translations.字子孝，曹操的族弟。自曹操起兵就跟随征战。当战局不利时，就激励部下继续英勇奋战，: Zixiao. Cao Cao's kinsman, who served from his first campaigns. He inspired troops in desperate situations and often turned defeat into victory. Chen Jiao praised his godlike courage. He later became Wei's Grand Marshal.
translations.字子廉，曹操的表弟。与兄长曹仁一起投奔曹操。身为曹军的核心大将，转战各地，奋战沙: Zilian. Cao Cao's cousin, who joined him with Cao Ren. A core commander of Cao's army, he fought across the realm and saved Cao Cao from danger several times.
translations.字孟德。文武兼备的一代奸雄，有杰出的战略眼光和预见能力。扫平黄巾后，又征讨董卓，: Mengde. A talented and ambitious leader with exceptional strategic vision. After fighting the Yellow Turbans and Dong Zhuo, he controlled the emperor to command the lords. Decades of war unified the north and laid the foundations of Wei.
translations.字德谋，惯使铁脊蛇矛。效力于东吴孙氏三代的老将。在赤壁之战中任副都督，协助正都督: Demou. A veteran of three generations of the Sun family, wielding an iron-ridged serpent spear. At Red Cliffs he served as deputy commander under Zhou Yu and helped defeat Cao Cao's army.
translations.字文台，兵法家孙子的后裔。任长沙太守时，参加了反董卓同盟并任先锋。第一个攻进洛阳: Wentai. Descendant of the strategist Sun Tzu. As governor of Changsha he led the coalition vanguard against Dong Zhuo. First into Luoyang, he found the Imperial Seal. He later died in an ambush while attacking Liu Biao.
translations.字文谦。本是曹操麾下的文官，后来转为武将，被列为五大将之一。他与张辽、李典共同把: Wenqian. Originally a civil officer, he became one of Cao Cao's five great generals. With Zhang Liao and Li Dian, he defended Hefei against Eastern Wu and earned great distinction.
translations.字曼成，魏破虏将军。从讨伐黄巾军时就跟随曹操，历经百战。性格冷静谨慎，多次制止同: Mancheng. A Wei general who served Cao Cao from the Yellow Turban campaigns. Calm and cautious through many battles, he often restrained reckless colleagues. He defended Hefei alongside Zhang Liao and Yue Jin.
translations.字本初，名门望族袁家头领。十八镇诸侯伐董卓时，他被推举为盟主之后，为称霸中原与曹: Benchu. Head of the prestigious Yuan family and elected leader of the coalition against Dong Zhuo. He later challenged Cao Cao for the Central Plains. Indecision and rejection of loyal counsel led to division and defeat at Guandu.
translations.字玄德，东汉中山靖王刘胜之后。被曹操认为是当世英雄，招揽了不少英雄豪杰、贤才隐士: Xuande. Descendant of Liu Sheng, Prince Jing of Zhongshan. Cao Cao regarded him as a hero of the age. He gathered gifted followers and founded Shu. After Emperor Xian abdicated, he proclaimed himself emperor of Shu Han.
translations.字翼德。与刘备、关羽桃园结义后，随刘备征战，同扶汉室。曾匹马单枪拒曹军于长阪；刘: Yide. Sworn brother of Liu Bei and Guan Yu, fighting to restore the Han. He held off Cao Cao's army alone at Changban and won repeated victories in Sichuan. A General of Chariots and Cavalry and one of Shu's Five Tiger Generals.

translations.曹操败在黄巾军手下。: Cao Cao was defeated by the Yellow Turbans.
translations.曹操败给了董卓。: Cao Cao was defeated by Dong Zhuo.
translations.曹操逃到西端！: Cao Cao must escape to the west edge!
translations.曹操骑的名马。可以提高移动力。: Cao Cao's famous horse. Increases movement.
translations.曹操！我们早晚还会见面的。: Cao Cao! We shall meet again!
translations.曹操，兵法最忌孤军深入，: Cao Cao, never advance deep without support.
translations.曹操，后事就交给你了。: Cao Cao, I leave the rest to you.
translations.曹操，就让我的刀来替你算个命吧！: Cao Cao, let my blade tell your fortune!
translations.曹操，我不会放过你的！: Cao Cao, I will not let you escape!
translations.曹操，殿后一事就交给你了。: Cao Cao, I leave the rearguard to you.
translations.曹操，马上去救援孙坚！: Cao Cao, go to Sun Jian's aid at once!
translations.有意思，我不会手软的，放马过来吧！: Interesting. I will not hold back. Come on!
translations.有我夏侯惇，曹军万无一失！: With Xiahou Dun here, our army cannot fail!
translations.木制的人偶。攻击时可以使敌人中毒。似乎对策略没有抵抗力，详细情况不明。: A wooden puppet whose attacks poison enemies. Apparently weak against tactics; details are unknown.
translations.木制的投石机。刚开始别期待有多大效果，经过锻炼后，威力就会逐渐增强。: A wooden catapult. Its power grows with training.
translations.木制的棍。刚开始别期待有多大效果，经过锻炼后，威力就会逐渐增强。: A wooden staff. Its power grows with training.
translations.本战胜利！完成整备后，点击下一战继续。: Victory! Finish preparations, then choose Next Battle.
translations.术士左慈在峨眉山得到的术书。可以模仿相邻武将所施展的策略。: A book of arts found by Zuo Ci on Mount Emei. Allows imitation of adjacent units' tactics.
translations.李儒你在这里收拾漏网之鱼。: Li Ru, catch any stragglers here.
translations.李儒，你要想法顶住！: Li Ru, find a way to hold them off!
translations.来吧，吕布！咱们再过几招！: Come, Lu Bu! Let us exchange a few more blows!
translations.果然有埋伏……！: An ambush, just as I feared!
translations.根本烧不到鹿砦！: They will never reach the fort!
translations.正是取胜的好机会！: This is our chance for victory!
translations.此人和以往所见官军不同。: He is unlike the imperial officers I have met before.
translations.此等话语，关某无法置之不理，: I cannot let that remark pass.
translations.步兵类兵种１。防御力优秀的部队。对付弓兵类时，以强大的攻击力为傲；但是攻击骑兵类: Infantry I. Excellent defense and strong attacks against archers, but ordinary offense against cavalry.
translations.步兵类兵种２。若能发挥其强大的防御力，可以使其成为我军部队的壁垒。对策略的抵抗力: Infantry II. Strong defense makes a reliable wall for the army. Also resists tactics well.
translations.步兵类兵种３。移动力上升，可以抵御敌人的猛攻。是非常值得倚赖的部队。: Infantry III. Improved movement and strong defense make a dependable frontline unit.
translations.武术家类兵种１。爆发力出色的部队。成功率高的防御和两段攻击是其魅力所在，也可以施: Martial artist I. High agility favors evasion and double attacks. Can also use tactics.
translations.武术家类兵种２。可攻击的范围更广，更容易运用。可以凭借着敏捷的移动力，玩弄敌军于: Martial artist II. Wider attack range and agile movement make it flexible.
translations.武术家类兵种３。拳圣是武艺已经登峰造极的人才能够获取的称号。其移动力也已经提升了: Martial artist III. A master of martial arts with improved movement.
translations.汉室早晚会灭亡，: The Han may fall one day,
translations.汉室气数已尽，今后是黄巾的天下了，: The Han's time is over. The realm belongs to the Yellow Turbans now!
translations.没办法，只有打了！: Then we have no choice but to fight!
translations.没想到有这样的豪杰，太过瘾了！: Such a worthy warrior! What a pleasure!
translations.没想到竟是如此惨烈……。: and I never expected it to be so fierce...
translations.没有下令，谁也不准擅自出击。: No one is to advance without my command.
translations.泛着白光的宝玉。为了召唤四神之一的白虎而制的宝玉，只能由风水士类装备。: A white orb used to summon the White Tiger. Only healers can equip it.
translations.泛着红光的宝玉。为了召唤四神之一的朱雀而制的宝玉，只能由策士类装备。: A red orb used to summon the Vermilion Bird. Only strategists can equip it.
translations.泛着青光的宝玉。为了召唤四神之一的青龙而制的宝玉，只能由骑马策士类装备。: An azure orb used to summon the Azure Dragon. Only mounted strategists can equip it.
translations.泛着黑光的宝玉。为了召唤四神之一的玄武而制的宝玉，只能由道士类装备。: A black orb used to summon the Black Tortoise. Only Taoists can equip it.
translations.派人对付后面的敌人！: Send men to deal with the rear!
translations.混乱，停止行动。: is confused and skips its action.
translations.漏网之鱼都由我收拾吧。: I will deal with any who get through.
translations.炮车类兵种１。射程无与伦比的远距攻击部队。用心锻炼的话，将来会有相当强的战力。: Catapult I. Exceptional range. Training turns it into a powerful weapon.
translations.炮车类兵种２。攻击影响范围更大，可以给予更多敌军造成损伤。: Catapult II. Attacks cover a wider area, damaging more enemies.
translations.炮车类兵种３。移动力、射程均上升，擅长的远距攻击将使我方迈向胜利之路。: Catapult III. Improved movement and range provide decisive ranged support.
translations.点击使用后，再点击自己或周围八格友军。\n满兵力或未中毒也会消耗；使用结束本次行:
Tap Use, then yourself or an ally in an adjacent tile.
Consumes the item even if not needed, and ends the unit's action.
translations.点击开始新战斗；各战场分别保存，F9 读取。\n固定阵容；伏兵开场显示；无单挑和:
Start a battle; each has a separate save. F9: load.
Fixed roster; ambush troops start visible; no duels or campaign growth.
translations.点击我军选择，点击空地移动，点击敌军攻击。\n右键 / Esc 撤回移动；W 待:
Tap a player unit, then a tile to move or an enemy to attack.
Right-click / Esc: undo; W: wait; E: end turn.
F5: save; F9: load; R: restart; P: items.
translations.点击重新开始，或读取存档。: Restart the battle or load a save.
translations.燕人张翼德在此！吕布，: Zhang Yide of Yan is here! Lu Bu,
translations.物资随存档保存；地点只能领取一次。: Items are saved. Each supply site can be collected once.
translations.独立战场：固定阵容，无单挑和伏兵事件。\n伏兵开场显示；所有友军可操控；B 选择:
Standalone battle: fixed roster, no duels or ambush events.
Allies are controllable; hidden troops start visible. B: battles.
translations.率军打仗你都做不到，: You cannot even lead an army,
translations.率领攻击力强大的熊作战的部队。每次攻击还具有令敌人麻痹的附加效果。对弓箭和策略的: Commands bears with powerful attacks that may immobilize foes. Weak against bows and tactics.
translations.率领爆发力出众的虎作战的部队。突击时会导致两个敌军反击，这点还请留意。对弓箭和策: Commands agile tigers. A charge can trigger counters from two foes. Weak against bows and tactics.
translations.王允的宝剑。曹操打算行刺董卓时，向王允借用的。可以提高策略的成功率。: Wang Yun's sword, borrowed by Cao Cao for his attempt on Dong Zhuo. Improves tactic success rates.
translations.现在就说这话，你会后悔的！: You will regret saying that so soon!
translations.现在想撤退也很困难…: Even retreat will be difficult now.
translations.现在撤退不是时候，击退剩下的敌人，: This is no time to retreat. Finish the remaining enemy
translations.现在的官军谁不这么想。: What imperial soldier thinks otherwise these days?
translations.现在要进攻董卓据守的汜水关，: We now attack Sishui Pass, held by Dong Zhuo.
translations.用黑布制作的服装。黑色可以提高灵力，具有提升最大MP值的效果。: Black cloth imbued with spiritual power. Increases maximum MP.
translations.皮制头盔。装备者可以提升最大HP值，但只有步兵类可以装备盔甲。: A leather helm that raises maximum HP. Helms are for infantry classes.
translations.皮制的手套。比布手套的效果好。: Leather gloves, more effective than cloth.
translations.皮制的盾。可以提高对敌人攻击的防御率。: A leather shield that improves evasion of enemy attacks.
translations.皮制的衣服。比布衣的防御力强。: Leather clothing, stronger than a cloth robe.
translations.皮制的马铠。马铠是为了弥补骑兵类防御远距攻击较差的弱点而制作的。这种骑兵类专用的: Leather horse armor for cavalry. Reduces ranged damage to offset cavalry's weakness against it.
translations.皮制铠甲。刚开始别期待有多大效果，经过锻炼后，威力就会逐渐提高。: Leather armor. Its protection improves with training.
translations.目标是敌军主将张宝、张梁。: Our targets are Zhang Bao and Zhang Liang.
translations.看你的了，元让。: I am counting on you, Yuanrang.
translations.看你还敢不敢出言不逊！: and put an end to your insolence!
translations.看来此地也非久留之处。: I should not linger here either.
translations.看来袁绍是当不了这个主帅了……。: He is not fit to lead this coalition...
translations.看来说得没错，哈哈哈！: It seems it was right! Hahaha!
translations.看来这同盟也维系不了多久了，: This alliance may not last much longer.
translations.看来这场仗恐怕相当艰苦……。: This will be a difficult battle...
translations.看起来好像赶上了。: It seems we arrived in time.
translations.真不愧是曹操，竟然识破了我的计策。: Well done, Cao Cao. You saw through my plan.
translations.真不愧是曹操，竟然识破了我的计策，: Well done, Cao Cao. You saw through my plan.
translations.真勇猛，不过接得住我这招吗，看招！: Brave indeed! But can you withstand this? Take that!
translations.真可惜啊，曹操。我可要先走了！: What a shame, Cao Cao. I shall take my leave!
translations.眼前才是最重要的。: We must deal with what is before us.
translations.短且小的枪。刚开始别期待有多大效果，经过锻炼后，威力就会逐渐增强。: A short spear. Its power grows with training.
translations.短而小的剑。刚开始别期待有多大威力，经过锻炼后，威力就会逐渐增强。: A small sword. Initially modest, it grows stronger with training.
translations.石制的宝剑。刚开始别期待有多大效果，经过锻炼后，威力就会逐渐增强。: A stone ritual sword. Its power grows with training.
translations.神弓开！箭火炽！: Divine bow, unleash your blazing arrows!
translations.稍有闪失就没命了。: One mistake could cost us our lives.
translations.竟然如此善战，我得记住此人。）: yet such a capable fighter. I must remember him.)
translations.竟然敢妄称相国，真是可笑！: yet call yourself Chancellor. How laughable!
translations.竹制的扇子。刚开始别期待有多大效果，经过锻炼后，威力就会逐渐增强。: A bamboo fan. Its power grows with training.
translations.策士类兵种１。施展攻击类策略的文官部队。擅长火类、水类、地类的策略。: Strategist I. A civil unit specializing in offensive fire, water and earth tactics.
translations.策士类兵种２。能够施展更加强力的攻击类策略，尤其擅长对付精神力低下的敌人。: Strategist II. Stronger offensive tactics are especially effective against enemies with low Spirit.
translations.策士类兵种３。究极的破坏力相当惊人！但是最怕被敌人绕到后方攻击。: Strategist III. Devastating tactical power, but vulnerable to attacks from behind.
translations.策略目标、地形或策略值无效。: Invalid tactic target or terrain, or insufficient MP.
translations.策略：选择策略和目标。: Tactics: choose a tactic and target.
translations.结束回合 E：所有我军待命，敌军开始行动。: End turn E: finish all player actions and begin the next phase.
translations.自乱阵脚只会正中敌人下怀！: Panic will only serve the enemy!
translations.舞女类兵种１。就能力而言，可说是武术家的女性翻版。可恢复周遭我军部队的异常状态。: Dancer I. Similar abilities to a martial artist. Can cure nearby allies' status ailments.
translations.舞女类兵种２。攻击范围广阔，可施展的策略虽少，不过个个都非常好用。: Dancer II. Wide attack range and a small but useful selection of tactics.
translations.舞女类兵种３。移动力上升。运用其敏捷的身手，便可纵横战场。: Dancer III. Improved movement and agility allow freedom across the battlefield.
translations.董卓之车骑将军。张绣的叔父。其妻邹氏是倾国美女。因军粮不足，去进攻南阳的刘表，中: Dong Zhuo's General of Chariots and Cavalry and Zhang Xiu's uncle. His wife, Lady Zou, was renowned for her beauty. Short of supplies, he attacked Liu Biao at Nanyang and was killed by an arrow.
translations.董卓也未必是我们的对手……。: even Dong Zhuo might not beat us!
translations.董卓就在眼前了啊……真不甘心。: Dong Zhuo was right before us... how bitter!
translations.董卓就在眼前，为了天下苍生，: Dong Zhuo is before us. For the sake of the people,
translations.董卓手下的勇将，身长九尺。十八镇诸侯伐董卓时，他自请军令，大破孙坚，斩鲍忠、祖茂: A towering warrior serving Dong Zhuo. He volunteered to face the coalition, defeated Sun Jian and slew Bao Zhong, Zu Mao, Yu She and Pan Feng. Guan Yu later killed him with a single stroke.
translations.董卓爱将。董卓被杀之后，与郭汜一起率军以报仇为名，重占长安。杀王允，挟献帝，逐吕: A favored officer of Dong Zhuo. With Guo Si, he retook Chang'an in the name of revenge, killed Wang Yun, seized Emperor Xian and expelled Lu Bu. His tyranny continued until Yang Biao's scheme turned him against Guo Si.
translations.董卓的女婿和军师。屡屡献计，帮助董卓掌大权、收吕布、破诸侯。识破了王允的「连环计: Dong Zhuo's son-in-law and strategist. His plans helped Dong Zhuo seize power, recruit Lu Bu and defeat the lords. He saw through Wang Yun's linked stratagem but his warnings were ignored. He was executed after Dong Zhuo's death.
translations.董卓部下。把赤兔马献给吕布，并说服吕布叛变，改投董卓。后来参加了王允暗杀董卓的计: An officer of Dong Zhuo. He gave Red Hare to Lu Bu and persuaded him to defect to Dong Zhuo. Later he joined Wang Yun's assassination plot, posing as an imperial envoy to lure Dong Zhuo into the palace.
translations.董卓部将。董卓死后，击退了兴兵讨逆的马腾、韩遂，追击敌军时，因为念旧，放走同乡韩: An officer of Dong Zhuo. After his lord's death, he defeated Ma Teng and Han Sui. Remembering their shared hometown, he let Han Sui escape during the pursuit. Li Jue and Guo Si had him killed for it.
translations.董卓部将。董卓被杀后，听从贾诩建议，率兵急袭长安，杀死王允等人，并与李傕共掌朝政: An officer of Dong Zhuo. After Dong Zhuo's death, Jia Xu advised him to attack Chang'an. He killed Wang Yun and shared control of the court with Li Jue. Later reduced to banditry, he was killed by his subordinate Wu Xi.
translations.董卓部将。追击遭到吕布伏兵的袭击后败逃的曹操，一箭射中曹操肩头，但被飞马赶到的夏: An officer of Dong Zhuo. He pursued Cao Cao after Lu Bu's ambush and shot him in the shoulder, but was slain by Xiahou Dun when the latter rode to the rescue.
translations.虎牢关，同盟军一时攻不下来，: Hulao Pass. Unable to take it at once,
translations.虽然很遗憾，但是不得不撤回主营。: Regrettable, but I must return to the main camp.
translations.虽然我有心阻止黄巾军的攻势…: I wanted to halt the Yellow Turbans,
translations.虽然身为贼军，毕竟也是一军之将，: Rebel or not, you command an army.
translations.袁将军，不可亲自出马！: General Yuan, you must not go yourself!
translations.袁将军，敌人很难对付，: General Yuan, the enemy is formidable.
translations.袁绍又何必处处树敌呢？: Why must Yuan Shao make enemies at every turn?
translations.袁绍，你从后面支援吧。: Yuan Shao, support us from the rear.
translations.西凉刺史。趁何进诛杀十常侍之际，进军洛阳，掌握了军政大权。废少帝立献帝，推行暴政: Governor of Xiliang. During the struggle between He Jin and the eunuchs, he entered Luoyang and seized power. He deposed the young emperor and installed Emperor Xian. His tyranny threw the realm into chaos and ushered in the Three Kingdoms era.
translations.西汉的飞将军李广惯用的弓。又称破魔弓，可以封杀敌人的策略。: The bow of Han's Flying General Li Guang. Also called the Demon-Breaking Bow, it can seal enemy tactics.
translations.要是输了就全完了。）: If we lose, it will all be over.)
translations.让他们知道同盟军的厉害吧。: and show them the coalition's might!
translations.让他们知道官军不是好惹的！: Show them the imperial army is no easy prey!
translations.让你一辈子忘不了锦马超之名！: You will never forget Ma Chao the Splendid!
translations.让我华雄先来收拾你们。: I will deal with you first!
translations.话虽如此，不过援军的骑兵队长是曹操，: Perhaps, but the cavalry commander is Cao Cao.
translations.该不该诓骗袁绍，让他按兵不动呢？: Should I persuade Yuan Shao to stay where he is?
translations.该兵种不能装备此物品。: This class cannot equip this item.
translations.该死的徐荣，这家伙运气实在太差。: Curse that Xu Rong. His luck is truly terrible.
translations.说不定敌人也会因此动摇的。: It might even shake their resolve.
translations.说得也对。好吧，这里交给你了，: Quite right. I leave this to you, then.
translations.请主公放心前去长安吧。: Proceed to Chang'an without concern, my lord.
translations.请先完成当前对话或关闭操作窗口。: Finish the dialogue or close the current window first.
translations.请先攻击、待命或取消移动。: Attack, wait or cancel the move first.
translations.请完成本战的胜利剧情和奖励，再进入下一战。: Finish the victory dialogue and rewards before continuing.
translations.请点选情报页面，或关闭情报返回战场。: Choose an information tab, or close it to return to battle.
translations.请选择红色目标，或右键返回。: Choose a red target, or right-click to go back.
translations.请选择绿色目标：自己或周围八格友军。: Choose a green target: yourself or an adjacent ally.
translations.请长按战场上的武将。: Hold a unit on the battlefield.
translations.诸葛亮喜欢穿戴的头巾。是所有头巾中效果最高的，可使装备者的最大MP值大幅上升。: Zhuge Liang's favored cap. The strongest cap, greatly raising maximum MP.
translations.诸葛亮常用的扇子。用白鹫的羽毛制成。由于灵力相当强，可以减少使用策略时消耗的MP: Zhuge Liang's white-feather fan. Its spiritual power reduces the MP cost of tactics.
translations.诸葛亮常穿的服装。可以提高穿者的精神力。: Zhuge Liang's customary cloak. Increases the wearer's Spirit.
translations.读取 F9：恢复本地存档。: Load F9: restore a local save.
translations.貂蝉纷舞！一闪即逝！: Diaochan dances! Gone in a flash!
translations.贪功绝对没好下场的。: Greed for glory never ends well.
translations.贼兵类兵种１。攻击力强大、士气高昂的部队。在山地、荒地可以发挥其真正的本领。对付: Bandit I. High attack and morale; excels in mountains and wasteland, with frequent critical hits.
translations.贼兵类兵种２。贼兵类可以施展地类的策略，将敌人诱入对自己有利的地形，然后一网打尽: Bandit II. Can use earth tactics. Lure enemies onto favorable terrain.
translations.贼兵类兵种３。移动方面已提升。可以凭借出现率高的致命一击打垮敌人。: Bandit III. Improved movement and frequent critical hits overwhelm opponents.
translations.走着瞧，早晚必报此仇！: Just wait! I will avenge this one day!
translations.身为武将，只有在战斗中才能体现价值。: A warrior proves his worth only in battle.
translations.轻巧结实的车轮。只有炮车类能装备，炮车装备后，可以高速移动。: Light, strong wheels usable only by catapults. Increase movement.
translations.迎战吕布时，随机增加一名我军武将。: Against Lu Bu, a random extra hero joins your side.
translations.还是让我们也出战吧？: Should we not fight as well?
translations.这下不行了，我得赶快逃跑！: This is hopeless. I must escape!
translations.这下被敌人夹击了……！: Now they have us from both sides!
translations.这不更有意思吗？: Would that not be all the better?
translations.这可关系到同盟军的名誉啊。: The coalition's honor is at stake!
translations.这可是我们立功的好机会。: This is our chance to win glory!
translations.这回一定要取下曹操首级，: This time I will take Cao Cao's head!
translations.这回该我们追击了。: Now it is our turn to pursue.
translations.这家伙只知道凭借自己的武勇……。: He relies on nothing but his own strength...
translations.这就是你我实力的差距。: Now you see the gap between us.
translations.这杯酒关某先谢过了……咕噜。: Thank you for the wine... gulp.
translations.这样下去前方的官军会被歼灭，: The troops ahead will be destroyed at this rate.
translations.这样袁绍才会甘心为同盟军提供财物，: This way, Yuan Shao will gladly fund the coalition.
translations.这次多亏了曹操才幸免于难，: We survived thanks to you, Cao Cao.
translations.这还有什么意义呢？: what is the point of all this?
translations.追！不要放过董卓！: After him! Do not let Dong Zhuo escape!
translations.选择独立战场会创建新队伍。\n继承成长和物资，请在胜利后点击下一战。:
A standalone battle creates a new party.
Use Next Battle after victory to carry over growth and items.
translations.选择空地移动，选择敌军攻击；右键取消。: Choose an empty tile to move, or an enemy to attack. Right-click to cancel.
translations.选择行动；方向键选择，回车确认，右键取消。: Choose an action. Arrows: select; Enter: confirm; right-click: cancel.
translations.道具 P：查看数量，选择道具后点击自己或周围友军。: Items P: view inventory, choose an item, then yourself or a nearby ally.
translations.道具不足、部队已行动，或目标不在范围内。: No item, unit already acted, or target out of range.
translations.道具：选择道具，再点击自己或周围友军。: Items: choose an item, then yourself or a nearby ally.
translations.道士于吉在山中得到的医学书。可以每回合恢复中毒、混乱、麻痹、禁咒等异常状况。: A medical book found in the mountains by Yu Ji. Cures poison, confusion, immobilization and silence each turn.
translations.道士类兵种１。施展妨碍类策略的文官部队。可运用诡异的策略削减敌人的战力。: Taoist I. Uses disruptive tactics to weaken enemy fighting power.
translations.道士类兵种２。道士类的最大之优点在于拥有许多不受天候地形影响的策略。可说非常方便: Taoist II. Many tactics ignore weather and terrain, making it convenient to use.
translations.道士类兵种３。移动力上升。可运用神出鬼没的策略，逼使敌人的精神状态陷入窘境。: Taoist III. Improved movement and deceptive tactics undermine the enemy's state of mind.
translations.那么只有突击李儒了。: Our only choice is to strike Li Ru.
translations.那么就拨调我军的一些军粮给阁下吧。: Then I shall share our supplies with you.
translations.那么我军就此告别，咱们在主营相会吧。: We take our leave. Let us meet at the main camp.
translations.那就是董卓属下的猛将华雄是吗！？: That is Dong Zhuo's fierce general Hua Xiong!?
translations.那我去放火。: Then I will light the fires.
translations.部队混乱，无法行动。: Unit is confused and cannot act.
translations.部队编制是否正规又有何关系？: what does a man's rank or regiment matter?
translations.重新开始 R：重新开始战斗，保留已有存档。: Restart R: restart the battle; existing saves remain.
translations.铁制头盔。是所有头盔中效果最好的，可使装备者的最大HP值大幅上升。: An iron helm, the strongest helm. Greatly raises maximum HP.
translations.铁制的宝剑。是所有宝剑之中威力最大的。: An iron ritual sword, the strongest standard ritual sword.
translations.铁制的弓。是所有弓中威力最大的。: An iron bow, the strongest standard bow.
translations.铁制的扇子。是所有扇子中威力最大的。: An iron fan, the strongest standard fan.
translations.铁制的投石机。是投石器中威力最大的。: An iron catapult, the strongest standard catapult.
translations.铁制的棍。是所有棍中威力最大的。: An iron staff, the strongest standard staff.
translations.铁制铠甲。是所有铠甲中防御力最强的。: Iron armor, the strongest standard armor.
translations.铁锁的两端连着金属制重锤的武器。无法预料的攻击轨迹，可以使眼前的敌人混乱。: Metal weights linked by an iron chain. Its unpredictable strikes can confuse enemies.
translations.铜制头盔。比皮盔的效果高。: A bronze helm, more effective than leather.
translations.铜制的宝剑。比石制宝剑威力大。: A bronze ritual sword, stronger than the stone version.
translations.铜制的投石机。比木制的投石器威力大。: A bronze catapult, stronger than the wooden version.
translations.铜制的棍。比木棍的威力大。: A bronze staff, stronger than a wooden staff.
translations.铜制的盾。比皮盾的效果高。: A bronze shield, more effective than leather.
translations.铜制的马铠。比皮制马铠的效果好。: Bronze horse armor, more effective than leather barding.
translations.铜制铠甲。比皮铠的防御力高。: Bronze armor, stronger than leather armor.
translations.长且重的枪。比短枪的威力大。: A long, heavy spear, stronger than a short spear.
translations.队长！好像是那边的人放的火，: Captain! Those men seem to have lit the fires.
translations.难道我真的要死在这里？唔……。: Am I truly to die here? Ugh...
translations.难道这就是跟错主子的下场吗？: Is this the price of choosing the wrong master?
translations.颍川之战：击败所有敌军，曹操不能战败。: Yingchuan: defeat all enemies. Keep Cao Cao alive.
translations.风水士类兵种１。施展恢复类策略的文官部队。是作战时不可缺少的后方支援部队。: Healer I. Uses recovery tactics. Essential support behind the battle line.
translations.风水士类兵种２。移动力上升，可以支援更多的我军部队。: Healer II. Improved movement lets it support more friendly units.
translations.风水士类兵种３。移动力更加提升。陷入窘境时，可以驰援而来的可靠部队。: Healer III. Further improved movement makes it a reliable rescue unit.
translations.风神打造的盾。可以提高对敌人攻击和策略两者的防御力。: The Wind God's shield. Improves defense against both attacks and tactics.
translations.食用后可以提高EXP 或等级的神奇果子。可以完全恢复HP和MP。: A magic fruit that increases EXP or level, and fully restores HP and MP.
translations.食用后可以提高智力的神奇果子。精神力也会得到一些提高。: A magic fruit that raises Intellect and slightly improves Spirit.
translations.食用后可以提高武力的神奇果子。攻击力也会得到一些提高。: A magic fruit that raises Strength and slightly improves Attack.
translations.食用后可以提高统率的神奇果子。防御力也会得到一些提高。: A magic fruit that raises Leadership and slightly improves Defense.
translations.食用后可以提高运气的神奇果子。士气也会得到一些提高。: A magic fruit that raises Luck and slightly improves Morale.
translations.食用后可以迅速移动的神奇果子。爆发力也会得到一些提高。: A magic fruit that improves quickness and slightly raises Agility.
translations.骑兵类兵种１。移动力与攻击力优异的部队。对步兵类的防御力很强，但是对弓箭、炮车的: Cavalry I. Excellent movement and attack; resists infantry, but is vulnerable to bows and catapults.
translations.骑兵类兵种２。发挥其高速的移动力，可以冲锋陷阵。不过必须留意不可孤军深入。: Cavalry II. Fast movement enables powerful charges. Beware of advancing without support.
translations.骑兵类兵种３。移动力已经进一步提升，务必让此兵种活跃于前线，冲垮阻挡的所有敌军！: Cavalry III. Even greater movement; use it to break through enemy lines.
translations.骑马策士类兵种１。施展攻击类策略的文官部队，以移动力与骑兵类相同而自豪。: Mounted strategist I. Offensive tactics with movement equal to cavalry.
translations.骑马策士类兵种２。擅长火类、风类的策略，只有骑马策士能够使用改变天气的策略。: Mounted strategist II. Specializes in fire and wind. Only this class can alter weather.
translations.骑马策士类兵种３。移动力更加快捷。可做为骑兵类、弓骑兵类的后援，大显身手。: Mounted strategist III. Greater speed makes excellent support for mounted troops.
translations.骨架大且重的弓。比短弓的威力大。: A large, heavy bow, stronger than a short bow.
translations.（嗯嗯！这家伙比我想像的要厉害！: (Hmm! He is stronger than I expected!
translations.（嗯，这个人能够讨好双方，: (Hmm. He manages to please both sides.
translations.（我可得先斩了华雄才行。唏喀！）: (I must reach Hua Xiong first. Hyah!)
translations.：点击自己或周围八格友军；无效果也会消耗。右键取消。: : select yourself or an adjacent ally. Consumed even if not needed. Right-click to cancel.
